name: OpenBrain v1.0
alternateName: OpenBrain: Confidence-Tiered Brain MRI Pseudo-Label Release v1.0
description: OpenBrain v1.0 is a confidence-aware whole-brain MRI parcellation release. It contains 35,838 brain-extracted T1-weighted MRI cases drawn from 607 OpenNeuro source datasets that carry CC0/public-domain-compatible license metadata. Each case ships (i) a SynthStrip brain mask, (ii) an automated whole-brain segmentation produced by a 3D residual-encoder U-Net trained on 1,189 scans with FreeSurfer 7.4.1 reference labels, (iii) seven raw reference-free quality-control values per case (brain-mask leakage, region-volume outliers, distant components, intensity homogeneity, committee Dice, voxel-vote entropy, committee volume coefficient of variation), (iv) seven within-source percentile-risk values derived from those checks, (v) the combined per-case risk score (the equal-weighted mean of the seven percentile risks), and (vi) a confidence tier (HighConf, Standard, or Flagged) at the 25%/75% quantile cuts on the combined risk score. Labels are produced by segmenters trained on FreeSurfer-curated reference labels; the release does not claim manually annotated ground-truth quality. Users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold cases using the released quality manifest without rerunning inference.

rai:dataLimitations: Released labels are produced by a brain-MRI segmenter trained on FreeSurfer 7.4.1 reference labels; they are not manually annotated ground truth. This dataset is not recommended for clinical decision support, individual-patient diagnosis, or fine-tuning of production diagnostic systems.

The canonical pseudo-label segmenter inherits FreeSurfer 7.4.1 region conventions; users following alternative atlases (DKT-only, AAL, JHU) may observe boundary differences not captured by the released quality panel.

The released quality panel is reference-free (no manual labels are consulted at scoring time) and source-local (axis values are normalised within each source dataset). It does not provide an absolute, manually anchored quality score.
Demographic metadata coverage is incomplete: age 63.8%, sex 72.9%, scanner manufacturer 74.9%, magnetic-field strength 71.0%, health status 29.0%. Missing values are reported as missing, not imputed.
The Mindboggle-101 manually annotated cohort (n=101) is the only human-annotated cohort referenced in our paper; it is held out for a confirmatory evaluation and is not redistributed in this release.
OpenBrain v1.0 is the CC0/public-domain-compatible subset of a larger 42,732-case provenance pool; non-CC0 sources are excluded and audited in metadata/excluded_cases_summary.csv.
rai:dataBiases: Source skew: the largest single OpenNeuro source contributes 7.2% of cases; the top-3 sources together contribute 15.1% and the top-10 contribute 26.4%.
Field strength is dominated by 3T scanners (~86% of cases with reported field strength). 1.5T (~6%) and 7T (~2%) are present but underrepresented.
Manufacturer skew: Siemens scanners produce ~69% of cases with reported manufacturer; Philips ~19%; GE ~12%.
Age coverage is skewed young (median 24 years on the 63% of cases with reported age); pediatric (<18) and elderly (>65) subpopulations are present but underrepresented.
Health-status coverage is only 28%; healthy/clinical stratification cannot be performed for the majority of cases. Subgroup analyses by health status should account for this.

Source-dataset ascertainment biases (sampling protocols, scanner choices, eligibility criteria) propagate from OpenNeuro to OpenBrain and are documented at the per-source level via dataset_doi and openneuro_dataset_name.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Sensitive category present: Health or medical data (T1-weighted brain MRI). The released volumes are skull-stripped (SynthStrip), which reduces but does not eliminate the residual risk of facial-feature reconstruction.
Subject identifiers are BIDS-derived and scoped to the source dataset (`<dataset>__<sub>__<ses>__<filestem>`); no cross-source identity linkage is provided.

All cases derive from OpenNeuro snapshots that carry CC0 or public-domain-compatible licence metadata; per-source records are in metadata/openneuro_dataset_audit.csv. Cases whose provenance was ambiguous, whose licence required manual review, or whose BIDS path could not be resolved were excluded; the audit trail is in metadata/excluded_cases_summary.csv.

Subject age and sex are present in metadata/openbrain_v1_0_metadata.csv for the subset of cases where the upstream OpenNeuro source recorded those fields; OpenBrain adds no new demographic, geographic, or socio-economic attributes.
rai:dataUseCases: OpenBrain v1.0 is a confidence-aware whole-brain MRI parcellation resource. Validated use cases: training brain-parcellation segmentation models on user-chosen confidence subsets and evaluating them against three external cohorts (paper Section 6); research on confidence-aware learning that consumes the per-case percentile-risk values directly; quality-control method development using the released raw quality checks; cross-cohort generalisation studies using the 607 OpenNeuro source datasets; metadata-stratified auditing of segmentation pipelines on the subset of cases where demographic and scanner fields are present. Not validated for: clinical decision support, individual-patient diagnosis, fine-tuning of production diagnostic systems, or extrapolation beyond the imaging protocols and pathology mix represented in OpenNeuro.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive impact: enables reproducible, large-scale evaluation of brain-MRI parcellation models on a population whose size and source diversity exceed the manually annotated cohorts the field has traditionally relied on. The release attaches per-case quality evidence to every label so users can filter, weight, or audit released labels rather than treating them as noise-free ground truth. Risks: over-reliance on segmenter-generated labels as if they were human-annotated; misuse for clinical decision support; demographic-stratified medical inference on the ~30% of cases with incomplete metadata. Mitigations: the release ships under CC0 with explicit not-recommended-for-clinical-use language; every released case carries a per-case quality manifest with seven reference-free checks; metadata coverage is reported field-by-field rather than imputed; a manually annotated external cohort (Mindboggle-101) is held out for confirmatory evaluation rather than being redistributed.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.prov:label: Source aggregation. Selecting OpenNeuro snapshots whose licence metadata is CC0 or public-domain-compatible, matching T1-weighted MRI scans to BIDS subject and session identifiers under each verified snapshot, and de-duplicating within source.

Preprocessing. Skull-stripping each scan with SynthStrip (FreeSurfer 7.4.1), normalising image intensity to zero mean and unit variance within the brain mask, and resampling to a 1 mm isotropic voxel grid. Cases that fail any of these steps are excluded before label generation and quality scoring.

Pseudo-label generation and quality scoring. Running a 3D residual-encoder U-Net (canonical released label) plus two committee segmenters (SwinUNETR and UNETR) on each case to produce a 110-class whole-brain parcellation. All three segmenters were trained against FreeSurfer 7.4.1 reference labels. Computing seven reference-free per-case quality checks (brain-mask leakage, region-volume outliers, distant components, intensity homogeneity, committee Dice, voxel-vote entropy, committee volume coefficient of variation), normalising each within its source dataset to a percentile risk in [0,1], averaging the seven percentile risks into a combined risk score, and assigning a confidence tier (HighConf, Standard, Flagged) at the 25%/75% quantile cuts on the combined score.

distribution.name: openbrain_v1_0_metadata.csv
distribution.description: Case-level core metadata for OpenBrain release candidates and released cases: BIDS identifiers, source dataset DOI/snapshot, demographic fields (age, sex, race, handedness, weight, BMI), scanner fields (manufacturer, model, field strength, repetition time, echo time, phase encoding direction), and release-path fields. The canonical 35,838-case hosted release is defined by metadata/openbrain_v1_0_qc_manifest.csv; this metadata table may include additional provenance-audited candidates retained for accounting. Coverage of demographic and scanner fields varies; see rai:dataBiases.

distribution.name: openbrain_v1_0_qc_manifest.csv
distribution.description: Per-case QC-7 manifest: case_id, source_dataset, raw QC values Q1..Q7, within-source percentile risks r1..r7, combined risk R, and confidence tier (HighConf/Standard/Flagged). Tier counts in v1.0: HighConf 8,960 (25.0%) / Standard 17,918 (50.0%) / Flagged 8,960 (25.0%).

distribution.name: label_map_whole_brain_segmentation.json
distribution.description: Mapping from OpenBrain internal segmentation label IDs (1..110) to anatomical names (FreeSurfer-aligned). Note: OpenBrain internal label IDs are NOT identical to FreeSurfer aseg IDs; resolve by name match.

distribution.name: openneuro_dataset_audit.csv
distribution.description: Per-OpenNeuro-source provenance audit: dataset name, snapshot tag, DOI, license, and case counts for release sources and retained provenance-accounting sources. The canonical 35,838-case hosted release is defined by metadata/openbrain_v1_0_qc_manifest.csv.

distribution.name: openneuro_case_path_audit.csv
distribution.description: Case-path provenance audit for release candidates and released cases: matched BIDS path within the OpenNeuro snapshot, original raw T1w image path, match status, and notes. The canonical 35,838-case hosted release is defined by metadata/openbrain_v1_0_qc_manifest.csv.

distribution.name: excluded_cases_summary.csv
distribution.description: Audit trail of cases excluded between the 42,732-case provenance pool and the 35,838-case CC0 release: per-case drop reason (license, OpenNeuro provenance missing, ambiguous BIDS match, raw T1w match missing, or manual review).

distribution.name: sha256_manifest.csv
distribution.description: SHA-256 hashes of every released artifact: image.nii.gz, brain_mask.nii.gz, whole_brain_segmentation.nii.gz per case.

distribution.name: case_files_image
distribution.description: Per-case T1-weighted preprocessed image (skull-stripped, intensity-normalized, spatially resampled).

distribution.name: case_files_segmentation
distribution.description: Per-case 110-class whole-brain pseudo-parcellation produced by M1 (canonical pseudo-label).

recordSet.name: cases
recordSet.description: One record per released case. Joins core metadata + QC-7 manifest on case_id.

field.name: case_id
field.description: Stable per-case identifier joining metadata and QC manifest. Format: <openneuro_dataset>__<sub-XXX>[__<ses-YYY>]__<file_stem>.

field.name: Q1_brain_leakage
field.description: Raw Q1 brain leakage value: fraction of foreground label voxels outside the brain mask. Lower is better.

field.name: Q2_volume_outliers
field.description: Raw Q2 volume-outlier count: number of labels with per-source Tukey-IQR-fenced volumes outside the source distribution. Lower is better.

field.name: Q3_distant_components
field.description: Raw Q3 distant-components score: fraction of foreground voxels in disconnected components far from each label's primary component. Lower is better.

field.name: Q4_intensity_cv
field.description: Raw Q4 image-label intensity coefficient of variation: median ROI-level coefficient of variation of T1w intensity. Lower is better.

field.name: Q5_committee_dice
field.description: Raw Q5 committee pairwise Dice: mean per-label Dice averaged over the three committee pairs. Higher is better.

field.name: Q6_voxel_entropy
field.description: Raw Q6 voxel-vote entropy: mean Shannon entropy of voxel-wise three-model votes within foreground. Lower is better.

field.name: Q7_volume_cv
field.description: Raw Q7 committee volume coefficient of variation: per-label CV of the three committee predictions' volumes, then averaged across labels. Lower is better.

field.name: r1
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q1 (range [0,1]; higher = riskier within the source dataset).

field.name: r2
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q2.

field.name: r3
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q3.

field.name: r4
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q4.

field.name: r5
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q5 (sign-flipped: higher Q5 -> lower r5).

field.name: r6
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q6.

field.name: r7
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q7.

field.name: R
field.description: Combined risk: equal-weighted mean of r1..r7. Range [0,1]; higher = riskier.

field.name: tier
field.description: Confidence tier at K=25%/75% cuts on R within v1.0. Values: 'HighConf' (lowest 25% of R), 'Standard' (middle 50%), 'Flagged' (highest 25%). v1.0 counts: HighConf 8,960; Standard 17,918; Flagged 8,960.

rai:dataCollection: OpenBrain v1.0 source data was collected between August 2024 and April 2026 by selecting OpenNeuro snapshots whose licence metadata is CC0 or public-domain-compatible, matching T1-weighted MRI scans to BIDS subject and session identifiers under each verified snapshot, and de-duplicating within source. Subsequent preprocessing, label generation, and quality scoring are described under prov:wasGeneratedBy.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Intensity normalisation to zero mean and unit variance within the brain mask.
Spatial resampling to a 1 mm isotropic voxel grid.
Preprocessing-integrity gating: cases where SynthStrip refused or where the resampled volume was empty are excluded before any label generation or quality scoring.
Source-local percentile-risk normalisation: each raw quality-check value is converted to a within-source rank in [0, 1] before being averaged into the combined risk score.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Released labels are produced by trained segmenters rather than human annotators. The canonical released label per case comes from a 3D residual-encoder U-Net trained on 1,189 brain MRI scans with FreeSurfer 7.4.1 reference labels. Two committee segmenters (SwinUNETR and UNETR), trained against the same FreeSurfer-aligned reference space, are run in parallel; their outputs are not the canonical released label but feed three of the seven per-case quality checks (committee Dice, voxel-vote entropy, committee volume coefficient of variation). No per-case manual review is performed on the OpenBrain release. Human supervision enters upstream through the FreeSurfer-curated training data of all three segmenters and downstream through Mindboggle-101, a manually annotated external cohort that is held out for confirmatory evaluation rather than redistributed.
